records.issue_text: apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:81 performs a non-atomic credential lookup and creation, allowing concurrent webhook deliveries to create duplicate user/app credentials; subsequent findFirst updates affect only one record, potentially leaving stale tokens in the others.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition in the webhook handler. Looking at lines 56-78 in app-credential.ts, the code does a `findFirst` to check if a credential exists, then either updates or creates based on the result. This is a classic TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race condition. If two concurrent webhook requests arrive for the same userId/appId combination, both could pass the `findFirst` check (finding no existing credential), and both would then execute the `create` path, resulting in duplicate credentials.
